figure_description:
A horizontal sequence of four figures composed of identical circles:
- Figure 1 consists of 1 circle, labeled "Figure 1" below.
- Figure 2 consists of 3 circles forming an inverted V-shape, with 1 circle at the top touching 1 circle to the lower left and 1 circle to the lower right, labeled "Figure 2" below.
- Figure 3 consists of 5 circles forming an inverted V-shape, with 1 circle at the apex, a branch of 2 circles extending downward and to the left, and a branch of 2 circles extending downward and to the right, labeled "Figure 3" below.
- Figure 4 consists of 7 circles forming an inverted V-shape, with 1 circle at the apex, a branch of 3 circles extending downward and to the left, and a branch of 3 circles extending downward and to the right, labeled "Figure 4" below.
